limits: The outcome windows are assumed to be calendar years. This comes from the spine model and was not checked against the staged HAI windows.
The FY 2026 and FY 2027 periods come from QualityNet pages and a search summary. The CMS PDFs for those years returned an error when fetched and have not been read.
The FY 2015 to FY 2021 periods come from one QualityNet table, with no second source.
Public flags for FY 2027 are not confirmed. A search summary gives its review period as Sep 10 to Oct 9 2026. If the flag table has none, the validation reports them as missing.
The PSI 90 period of FY 2025 differs between QualityNet and a CMS contractor slide deck. The mapping uses only the NHSN period, which both sources give as 1/1/22 to 12/31/23.

omitted_window_years.2020: No program year's NHSN period ends in 2020: CMS excluded all CY 2020 data.
omitted_window_years.2021: FY 2023 (NHSN period 1/1/21 to 12/31/21) has no hospital scores or flags: CMS did not calculate measure scores for any hospital for FY 2023.

rule: An outcome window year maps to the HAC Reduction Program year whose CDC NHSN HAI performance period ends in that calendar year (program year = window year + 2).

sources.covers: Program year table FY 2015 to FY 2027 with footnotes on CY 2020 and CY 2021 exclusions and the FY 2023 pause
FY 2027 and FY 2028 periods and the two-year period advanced by one year each program year
Key program dates for FY 2022 to FY 2024 (read in full from the PDF text)
FY 2025 overview slides: NHSN period 1/1/22 to 12/31/23 (its PSI 90 period differs from the QualityNet table)
